label: Held device first person
camera_rules: Define the device, operator, grip, optics, and mounting or holding method.
Camera faults and motion follow the declared device rather than human vision.
Keep operator limbs and device occlusion consistent when visible.
continuity_rules: Use only optics and motion available to the declared device.
Separate device audio from character subjective hearing when they differ.
knowledge_policy: Apply the declared focalization and do not reveal information outside its scope unless the shot plan records a deliberate change.
